items.name: standard-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible sections with the chevron at the end, start, inline after the title, swapped in for the icon on hover, or hidden. Divided or plain (sidebar) tone, optional single-open.

items.name: action-wheel
items.title: Action Wheel
items.description: Radial action menu modeled on the Logi Options+ Actions Ring: a small gray close button in the center, a ring of solid circular actions, and a label card pushed outward from each one. Opens at the cursor on right-click via ActionWheelContextMenu. Actions with nested items open a submenu on an outer arc, and variant="arc" drops the ring for a launcher that fans actions toward a direction. Labels always, on hover, or off (tooltips), full ring or arc via startAngle and sweep, solid, violet, primary, secondary, and surface tones, compact, default, medium, and large sizes, and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: activity-overview
items.title: Activity Overview
items.description: A year of activity: headline total, streak stats, a contribution graph and a panel for the picked day.

items.name: standard-alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert from the Standard library.

items.name: app-bar
items.title: App Bar
items.description: Material 3 top app bar: Small, Medium and Large flexible (big title that collapses on scroll), and Search, with leading nav, trailing actions and a fill on scroll.

items.name: app-grid
items.title: App Grid
items.description: Launcher grid of folders after the Windows 11 Start menu: each tile shows a 2x2 of items, and a mini cluster in the fourth slot opens the full folder.

items.name: arrangeable-grid
items.title: Arrangeable Grid
items.description: Inventory-style grid of fixed slots, any size from 1 × 10 to 5 × 5: drag to move or swap, stack with a merge rule, per-slot accept rules, linked grids in one root, drop targets such as a trash button, sources that drag new items in, files dropped from the desktop, drag out or Delete to remove, full keyboard support, and a headless useArrangeableGrid hook for adding, removing, counting and sorting items from code.

items.name: array
items.title: Array
items.description: Lays any elements out along a line, arc, circle, SVG path or hand-drawn points. Justify spreads them like justify-content (between, around, evenly) or packs them gap apart (start, center, end); offset shifts items along the path; orient turns them to follow it.

items.name: art
items.title: Art
items.description: Layer of positioned art pieces (images, SVGs or any element). Each piece has x/y, width, rotate and depth, an `enter` animation (rise, pop, spin, blur...) staggered in order, and an `idle` loop. `parallax` drifts pieces with the pointer by depth. Honours reduced motion.

items.name: article
items.title: Article
items.description: Flexible article layout: single column or sidebar/sidebar-start page layouts, a breakout content grid with wide/full-bleed figures, split sections, header, aside and footer parts, and automatic prose styles for plain markup.

items.name: atom-grid
items.title: Atom Grid
items.description: Dot-matrix loading indicator: a small grid of dots lit in a moving pattern, pure CSS with no JavaScript once rendered. Orbit, orbit-duo, diamond, vortex, spiral, ripple, pulse, snake, scan, wave, diagonal, rain, cross, saltire, corners, checker, sparkle and heart patterns; any grid size, dot size, gap and speed; circle, rounded, square or diamond dots with an optional glow.

items.name: audio-display
items.title: Audio Display
items.description: An audio player with cover art, title and artist, a seek bar that can draw a decoded or given waveform, speed, mute and download.

items.name: autocomplete-input
items.title: Autocomplete Input
items.description: Autocomplete Input from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar from the Standard library.

items.name: badge-select
items.title: Badge Select
items.description: Badge Select from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge from the Standard library.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Announcement bar, inline or floating on any edge, static or scrolling like a stock ticker.

items.name: bar
items.title: Bar
items.description: One row with optional leading, label and trailing slots, like a Card cut to a single line. A button by default; a link or static row with asChild.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Responsive bento layout with preset variants (uniform, featured, hero, sidebar, split, mosaic), per-tile col/row spans, and tile surface variants.

items.name: block-editor
items.title: Block Editor
items.description: Notion-style document editor built on ProseKit: the Standard Toolbar (block type, history, text formats, list indent, insert table and divider), a / command menu, a format menu with a link field over selections, drag handles to reorder blocks, task and toggle lists, tables with row and column menus, code blocks, and Markdown shortcuts. onChange gives JSON, HTML and plain text.

items.name: button-array
items.title: Button Array
items.description: Button Array from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button from the Standard library.

items.name: calendar-heatmap
items.title: Calendar Heatmap
items.description: Contribution graph: a cell per day, a column per week, month and weekday labels, today marked.

items.name: caption
items.title: Caption
items.description: Caption from the Standard library.

items.name: card-bar
items.title: Card Bar
items.description: Card Bar from the Standard library.

items.name: card-corridor
items.title: Card Corridor
items.description: Two walls of cards that meet and overlap in the middle, fan out and run toward you, growing until they pass the edges while new ones keep arriving. Items cycle on every lap, children sit over the gap, and it sizes from its own width. Directions out or in, pause on hover, pauses off screen and holds still for reduced motion.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: A card holding a fixed-column grid of icon tiles, after the Windows tray overflow flyout. Takes an items array or CardGridItem children; arrow keys move between tiles.

items.name: standard-card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel from the Standard library.

items.name: cell-grid
items.title: Cell Grid
items.description: Grid of equal cells on a color ramp, filled by row or by column, with per-cell colors, marks and keyboard selection. The base of heatmaps, timelines and seat maps.

items.name: character-chat
items.title: Character Chat
items.description: Visual-novel dialogue box with no input: the speaker's name, the line typed out a letter at a time with pauses after punctuation, and a portrait standing beside the box on either side. Click or press Enter/Space to finish the line, then again for the next; *asterisks* for italics. Default, classic, soft, tab, frame and minimal looks, arrow, chevron, dots or next marks, per-speaker accent colours, thinking dots, auto-advance, a controlled or uncontrolled line index, and a trailing slot for save or replay buttons. Respects reduced motion.

items.name: standard-chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart from the Standard library.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat Card
items.description: Chat window block built on Message Scroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment and Marker with Standard pieces: an optional header bar, a thread that anchors each new turn and follows streamed replies, a jump-to-latest button, system separators, avatars and author names for group threads, file attachments, a shimmering pending line, copy and regenerate actions on replies, prompt suggestions in the empty state, follow-up chips, bubble-less plain replies for agent transcripts, and a composer that sends on Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line) with a slot for tools such as a model picker or mic. SideChat docks it to a corner as a support widget: a launcher button with an unread count that opens a floating panel with a close button.

items.name: standard-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox from the Standard library.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Pressable tag: filter/selection chips with a check when on, action chips with an icon, and removable filter chips. Looks interactive so it is never mistaken for a Badge.

items.name: choice-label
items.title: Choice Label
items.description: Choice Label from the Standard library.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Code from the Standard library.

items.name: color-grade
items.title: Color Grade
items.description: Color treatment: sepia, black and white, noir, vivid, muted, vintage, warm, cool, duotone. Wraps content or grades the backdrop.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A color field on the browser color picker: a swatch that opens the native picker, a hex field that accepts #rgb or #rrggbb, preset swatches, and an eyedropper where the browser supports it. Controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: column-filter
items.title: Column Filter
items.description: A column menu with Sort A → Z / Z → A buttons, a condition picker (contains, between, greater than, is empty and more) and a searchable checklist of the column's values. Each section shows only when you give it something to work with, and edits stay a draft until Apply hands the filter to onValueChange. Drop it in a popover for table or grid headers.

items.name: comments
items.title: Comments
items.description: Comment section block built from Standard pieces: a heading with a Newest/Oldest sort select, a reply textarea with its submit button inside, a Login or Subscribe prompt for signed-out visitors, and a list of comments with avatars and relative times. Controlled or uncontrolled sort, async onSubmit that clears the box when it resolves, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to post, and an empty state.

items.name: comparison-slider
items.title: Comparison Slider
items.description: Before/after comparison: two layers (image srcs or any content) split by a divider you drag, scrub on hover, or move with the arrow keys. Horizontal or vertical, optional corner labels, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Confirm Dialog from the Standard library.

items.name: control-bar
items.title: Control Bar
items.description: Control Bar from the Standard library.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard, from a string or a function read at click time, and shows a check and "Copied" for a moment.

items.name: csv-button
items.title: CSV Button
items.description: Exports rows to a UTF-8 .csv file that Excel opens cleanly, with quoting and a custom delimiter. Shows as an icon, iconed text or text.

items.name: cursor-label
items.title: Cursor Label
items.description: A label that follows the pointer on one of 8 sides and flips near edges. Holds text, any element, or a function of the pointer position.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: Custom cursor replacement with dot, ring, dot-ring, crosshair, spotlight, blend, arrow and trail variants.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Excel-style spreadsheet grid with A1 coordinates and a Name Box, letter and number headers with optional labels, range selection, and keyboard navigation. Drag the fill handle down, right, or diagonally to continue number, date, weekday, and Item 1 series, or press Ctrl+D to copy the cell above. Insert, delete, duplicate, hide, and freeze rows and columns from the right-click menu or the + between headers. Opt-in sorting by header click, per-column filter buttons with value lists and conditions, and declarative JSON formatting rules that style cells, rows, or columns (background, text color, weight, decoration, alignment, borders, any CSS) when values match. Cells render components by type (text, number, checkbox, select, date, or your own), rows and columns are virtualized for 10,000+ rows, and every edit is a change list with undo and redo that onChanges or an adapter can sync to a database.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: TanStack Table v9 data table. Sort by header click, search every column, filter by text or by a column's distinct values, and page through rows. Select rows with a checkbox column and run bulk actions on the selection. Resize, drag to reorder, pin to either edge, and hide columns; switch between compact, default and comfortable density. Show nested rows as an expandable tree with getSubRows, edit cells in place, and export the filtered rows as CSV or JSON.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date Picker from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog from the Standard library.

items.name: dialslide
items.title: Dialslide
items.description: Horizontal slider for any row, with a calendar variant: scroll buttons, drag, keyboard and edge fades.

items.name: digital-clock
items.title: Digital Clock
items.description: Seven-segment LED clock: slanted bevelled digits, a blinking colon and faint unlit segments. 12 or 24-hour, seconds, AM/PM, time zones, a fixed time, and an optional housing with a glass face.

items.name: display-frame
items.title: Display Frame
items.description: The shared chrome for the Display pieces: a header with icon, title, meta and actions, an optional toolbar row, and copy, open, download and view-switch actions.

items.name: distort
items.title: Distort
items.description: Spatial effect: waves, ripple, warp or blur, optionally animated. Wraps content or distorts the backdrop.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Divider from the Standard library.

items.name: download-button
items.title: Download Button
items.description: Downloads a file from a URL, or one built on click from a Blob. Shows as an icon, iconed text or text.

items.name: draggable
items.title: Draggable
items.description: Sortable list: drag rows, grid chips or a horizontal strip by pointer or keyboard, whole item or grip, and move items between lists.

items.name: draw-display
items.title: Draw Display
items.description: A touch-friendly sketch pad: pen, highlighter and eraser, colors and sizes, undo and redo, two-finger tap to undo, palm rejection with a stylus, and SVG or PNG export.

items.name: dynamic-tabs
items.title: Dynamic Tabs
items.description: Browser-style tab strip: add, close and rename tabs (double-click, press and hold, or F2), overflow scroll arrows, arrow-key navigation, pinned tabs, plus a useDynamicTabs hook for local state.

items.name: email-button
items.title: Email Button
items.description: Opens a mailto: link with recipients, cc, bcc, subject and body filled in, or copies the address to the clipboard.

items.name: excel-button
items.title: Excel Button
items.description: Exports rows to an .xlsx workbook with no spreadsheet library, keeping numbers as values under a bold frozen header. Shows as an icon, iconed text or text.

items.name: fab
items.title: Fab
items.description: Material 3 FAB in FAB, medium, and large sizes with primary, secondary, and surface tones, extended labels, and the expressive FAB menu, plus utilitek's 32px compact chrome that grows into a pill on hover, a FabStack pinned to any of eight edge slots that can be dragged and snapped between them, and scroll collapse/hide.

items.name: field-label
items.title: Field Label
items.description: Field Label from the Standard library.

items.name: filter-select
items.title: Filter Select
items.description: Filter Select from the Standard library.

items.name: flip-dots
items.title: Flip Dots
items.description: Electromechanical flip-dot board: two-sided discs flip edge-on in a column sweep. Built-in marquee, text, clock, wave, ripple, rain, Life, checker, wipe, sparkle, bounce, pong and snake patterns, a controlled value, and press-and-drag painting. Shaded disc or flat faces, in circle, square, rounded, diamond, hexagon, triangle, star or plus shapes.

items.name: floating-window
items.title: Floating Window
items.description: Floats any element at one of nine spots on the viewport or its positioned parent. Optionally draggable: drop it anywhere and it snaps to the nearest spot, with a preview outline while dragging and arrow-key moves when focused.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: Form Field from the Standard library.

items.name: gantt
items.title: Gantt
items.description: Project schedule: a WBS task table frozen beside a day, week, month or quarter timeline. Plan bars fill with progress, actual bars shade from green to red as they slip, forecasts overshoot in violet, and milestones sit as diamonds. Phases roll up their children; unfinished dependencies grey a task out and a child outside its phase turns red.

items.name: gradient
items.title: Gradient
items.description: Color transition layer: linear, radial, conic or mesh. Behind or over any relative isolate box.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Heading from the Standard library. `display` applies landing-page headline rules (60/48px, extrabold, -0.4px tracking, line height 1, 1000px max width); HeadingHighlight colours a number in it.

items.name: headline
items.title: Headline
items.description: A landing-page section: a display Heading, one paragraph, one call to action and one image. `align` stacks it centred or puts the media beside the copy.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Matrix of values shaded on a ramp, with row and column labels, a Less-More legend and a readout of the hovered cell.

items.name: hero-card
items.title: Hero Card
items.description: A hero on a card. Title, subtitle, actions and trailing art each take one of nine positions, over Surface `layers` data or layer components (Gradient, Noise, Shader, Art) passed as children.

items.name: image-shader
items.title: Image Shader
items.description: WebGL image effect layer from Paper Shaders. Filter: paper texture, fluted glass, water, dithering, halftone dots, halftone CMYK, lens distortion. Logo: heatmap, liquid metal, gem smoke. Takes a same-origin or CORS image src, with Paper's presets.

items.name: image-upload
items.title: Image Upload
items.description: Image Upload from the Standard library.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: Image from the Standard library.

items.name: increment
items.title: Increment
items.description: A value nudged with minus and plus buttons, like gap 32. Hold to repeat; arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End step it from the keyboard.

items.name: indicator
items.title: Indicator
items.description: Presence dot for avatars and people lists: online, away, busy, offline. Its own colour set, so busy red never reads as unread.

items.name: infinite-canvas
items.title: Infinite Canvas
items.description: Pannable, zoomable surface that goes on forever. Drag, scroll or hold space to pan; pinch or ctrl + scroll to zoom at the pointer. Draggable items with snapping and keyboard moves, dots, grid or ruled backgrounds, zoom controls, a minimap, and a controlled view, item list and selection.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: Lays out any components as a list, responsive grid or masonry and calls onLoadMore as the end scrolls into view. Takes items with renderItem or composed children; scrolls the page or its own container, loads upward for chat history, or waits for a Load more button. useInfiniteList turns a page fetcher into its props, with loading, error and retry.

items.name: info-icon
items.title: Info Icon
items.description: Info Icon from the Standard library.

items.name: inline-editor
items.title: Inline Editor
items.description: Rich text editor built on ProseKit with no fixed toolbar: select text and a format menu with a link field floats over it. Markdown shortcuts still work. tone="ghost" edits in place without a border.

items.name: input-calculator
items.title: Input Calculator
items.description: Headless formula field: type spreadsheet-style maths with variables and functions and get the result live.

items.name: input-fill
items.title: Input Fill
items.description: Masked text field that inserts literals as you type and shows the rest of the template as a faint fill.

items.name: standard-input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: Input Otp from the Standard library.

items.name: json-display
items.title: Json Display
items.description: JSON as a collapsible, color-coded tree with item counts, expand and collapse all, a Raw view, copy, and parse errors shown over the text.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: Json Viewer
items.description: An interactive JSON explorer on CSS grid: label and value cells, boxed objects and arrays under type headers, click any key to collapse, parse JSON strings in place, hovered path in the footer, and an optional Input view.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Board of columns with cards that drag between them, column counts and limits, and an Add card button.

items.name: standard-kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Kbd from the Standard library.

items.name: lexical-editor
items.title: Lexical Editor
items.description: Rich text editor built on Lexical with the Standard Toolbar: block types, history, text formats, alignment, and Markdown shortcuts.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Link from the Standard library.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A card of Bars. Rows as data or composed: links, selectable options (value / onValueChange), expandable tree branches, collapsible sections and separators. Title, trailing and footer slots; default, quiet, outline or ghost tone.

items.name: loading-state
items.title: Loading State
items.description: Loading State from the Standard library.

items.name: markdown-display
items.title: Markdown Display
items.description: Markdown rendered with no dependencies and no raw HTML: headings, nested and task lists, tables, quotes, code blocks and safe links, with an optional Preview / Source switch.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown Editor
items.description: Rich text editor built on ProseKit that reads and writes Markdown (GFM: tables, task lists, strikethrough). Format with the Standard Toolbar or Markdown shortcuts, or switch to the source or a side-by-side view and edit the Markdown directly. Controlled with value, defaultValue and onValueChange.

items.name: mask
items.title: Mask
items.description: Soft alpha cutout: fade, edges, vignette or spotlight. Wraps content or groups other layers.

items.name: mention-composer
items.title: Mention Composer
items.description: Chat-style message box built on ProseKit: type @ to mention a person (with avatars) and # to add a tag, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. onSubmit returns the text, HTML, JSON and every mention as data. leading and trailing slots hold extra buttons.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Menu from the Standard library.

items.name: mic-button
items.title: Mic Button
items.description: Turns the microphone on and off with getUserMedia, with a live input level meter while on. Hands the stream to onStreamChange and stops every track on unmount. Needs a secure (https) page.

items.name: miller-select
items.title: Miller Select
items.description: Miller-column picker from the utilitek timesheet Work Performed field: sections as tabs, then group, header, and checkbox columns side by side, with a search that lists matches from every group. Popover on desktop, stacked bottom sheet on mobile.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode Toggle
items.description: Light, dark and system theme switch as a menu, a one-click toggle or a segmented control. Uncontrolled it sets the app theme through next-themes, so wrap the app in a next-themes ThemeProvider with attribute="class"; pass value and onValueChange to drive a scoped preview instead.

items.name: mood-text
items.title: Mood Text
items.description: Text that carries a mood. Each word is a span with a stack of effects, one per slot: motion, pose, size, tracking, case, font, weight, draw, ink, glow and fade. A mood sets the whole line; highlights pick out phrases with presets such as goldWave, wrath or phantom.

items.name: navigation
items.title: Navigation
items.description: Navigation from the Standard library.

items.name: noise
items.title: Noise
items.description: Random texture layer: grain, paper fibers or clouds, from SVG turbulence. Optional film jitter.

items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: Unread marker pinned to an icon: dot, count, or capped count (999+). Red alert tone by default, with brand and neutral tones for non-urgent counts.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Text box for numbers: digits only, clamps to min/max and rounds on blur, Enter jumps to the next field.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page Header from the Standard library.

items.name: paragraph
items.title: Paragraph
items.description: Paragraph from the Standard library.

items.name: parallax
items.title: Parallax
items.description: Parallax from the Standard library.

items.name: pattern
items.title: Pattern
items.description: Repeating shape layer. Basic: dots, grid, lines, diagonal, checker. Graphic: waves, pinstripe, barcode, polka, triangles, diamonds, dotted, double and dashed diagonals, band. Decorative: speed lines, motion lines, sunburst, seigaiha, asanoha, kikko, shippo, sparkles, sakura. Material: paper, newsprint, linen, woodgrain, pegboard, blueprint, fold.

items.name: pdf-display
items.title: Pdf Display
items.description: A PDF in the browser viewer with a title bar, open and download actions, a starting page and zoom, and a fallback card where PDFs cannot show inline.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Phone number field with a searchable country picker: formats as you type and reports E.164.

items.name: pill
items.title: Pill
items.description: Split badge with a muted label on the left and a contrasting value on the right, in four corner radii.

items.name: planetary
items.title: Planetary
items.description: Rings of items orbiting a centre, built on Array. Rings alternate direction (inner clockwise, next counter-clockwise) unless a ring sets its own; each ring takes its own radius, duration and starting offset. Items stay upright while their ring turns. Pauses on demand or on hover; honours reduced motion. PlanetaryItem is a round body for rings and the centre.

items.name: popover-wizard
items.title: Popover Wizard
items.description: Small multi-step panel anchored to its trigger: header dots, Back and Next, for tours and quick setup.

items.name: standard-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover from the Standard library.

items.name: print-button
items.title: Print Button
items.description: Opens the print dialog for the page, or prints one element in a hidden frame with the page's styles. Shows as an icon, iconed text or text.

items.name: standard-progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress from the Standard library.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio from the Standard library.

items.name: rater
items.title: Rater
items.description: Star rating input with half steps, tones, sizes and custom icons.

items.name: reel
items.title: Reel
items.description: An endless reel of items. Straight, it loops them left, right, up or down like a logo ticker, with edge fades and a hover speed that eases to a stop. Given an SVG path, the items ride along it, round a closed loop or in one end and out the other, turned to face along it or kept upright; with drawable, press and drag to draw the path. Flow sends items as a stream, a number at a time or at random gaps; cycles, rest and loop set how many passes run before it pauses or stops, and playOnView starts it when it scrolls into view.

items.name: refresh-button
items.title: Refresh Button
items.description: Refresh Button from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable from the Standard library.

items.name: responsive-tooltip
items.title: Responsive Tooltip
items.description: Hover tooltip on desktop, tap popover on touch devices.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Animates content in as it scrolls into view: fade, rise, drop, slides, zoom, pop, spin or blur. `stagger` cascades direct children, `once={false}` replays on every pass, and `useReveal` exposes the in-view state. Plain CSS transitions; honours reduced motion.

items.name: screentone
items.title: Screentone
items.description: Manga halftone tone: dots, lines, crosshatch, diamonds, rings or noise that grow with a graded tone (top, bottom, center, edges, corner) or an organic one (clouds, folds, marble, streaks). Optional rough printed edges.

items.name: standard-scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll Area from the Standard library.

items.name: scroll-horizontal-button
items.title: Scroll Horizontal Button
items.description: Scroll Horizontal Button from the Standard library.

items.name: scroll-mask
items.title: Scroll Mask
items.description: Scroll Mask from the Standard library.

items.name: scroll-track
items.title: Scroll Track
items.description: Scroll progress line that fills as the reader scrolls: a straight bar pinned under a header, a vertical line, or any SVG path, with a marker node that rides the tip and can turn to face along the path. Tracks the whole scroller, one element, or a pixel range from start to end, and writes progress to --scroll-track-progress with no React renders.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Search from the Standard library.

items.name: standard-select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select from the Standard library.

items.name: shader
items.title: Shader
items.description: WebGL shader layer from Paper Shaders. Color: mesh, static mesh, static radial, grain, color panels. Noise: perlin, simplex, neuro, voronoi, warp, swirl, spiral, waves. Dots: dot orbit, dot grid, dithering, metaballs. Light: spotlight, stage beams, shine sweep, bokeh, god rays, smoke ring, pulsing border, aurora. Fractal: mandelbrot dive, julia, burning ship, newton, sierpinski carpet, apollonian gasket. Retro: hypno, plasma, tunnel, kaleidoscope, starfield. Code: matrix rain, hacker terminal, synthwave. Each with presets.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events along a line. Each entry takes elements for its badge, date, title, description, extra content and marker. Vertical or horizontal, content on one side or alternating, the date beside the content or across the line; ring, number or dot markers, solid, dashed or pin connectors, and per-entry colors. Give entries dates to space them by time, draw gaps solid, dashed or dotted by length with labels, group by day, month or year, and mark the current entry; plus reversed order, loading placeholders and an empty state.
